description: Get the historical time series of business formations for a specific industry/SSIC code. Returns annual counts from 1990 to present. Use SSIC code (e.g. '62' for IT) or 'Total' for all industries.

ssic.description: SSIC code to query (e.g. '62' for Computer Programming/IT, '70' for Management Consultancy, 'Total' for all industries).

years_back.description: Limit to last N years. Default: all available.

name: sg_formations_history
